directive.quote: Avery, 2026-11-03: move code, never rewrite it: port the correct parts one to one, carry the original tests.

old_copy.deleted_with: old trillion's src/device-distribution.mjs leaves with the account server it serves (src/devices.mjs, src/setup-access.mjs, src/screen-reads.mjs); the engine's own reader is trillion-rust src/local_account/setup_distribution/value.rs

preserve: only the safe public projection is kept: no tester identity or arbitrary provider payload
an observation needs its real check time and a bounded expiry
an available route needs an allowed HTTPS destination with no credentials
a route cannot outlive its observation
allowed_deltas: the bounds and sources are this folder's read-data/distribution.json, as the engine's product/devices.json distribution block holds them
routeEligibility and compareVersion, used only by the account's install-way reader, are not carried
banned_substitutions: a private or unconfigured channel in a shared observation

test_refs: tools/app-release-access/test/app-distribution.test.mjs the public projection keeps only safe data and never includes tester identities or arbitrary provider payloads
tools/app-release-access/test/app-distribution.test.mjs source identity, route identity, safe HTTPS destination and bounded clock window are required
